rule: Work on one feature at a time. A feature moves to passing only when its verification command succeeds. Verification commands are proposals; finalise each one before starting the feature.
order_note: Reordered 2026-10-04: first goal is prompt-to-video end to end, quality second. F04 (transitions/captions), F05b (music/ducking/loudness) and F06 (determinism) move after the pipeline and web MVP. Generated visuals (F16 images with motion, F17 video clips) were pulled forward from roadmap Phase 5 to right after the web UI (F14), by the user's decisions the same day: the UI keeps its original place right after the pipeline (F13).

features.behavior: Pinned Nix toolchain, api/ crates/retake_render/ web/ skeletons each with one passing test, justfile (setup, dev, test, check, render), boundary check, CI running check + test, PROGRESS.md.
features.verification: just check && just test && just check-boundaries

features.behavior: Load a spec JSON, validate it against spec/video.schema.json (jsv, draft 2020-12) plus a lean set of semantic rules; return all errors as JSON Pointer paths. API: Retake.Spec.load/1 and validate/1 returning {:ok, spec} | {:error, [%{path, rule, message}]}. Lean rules: asset ids exist; voice-over fits scene (offset + audio length <= scene duration); transition shorter than both neighbouring scenes; words in order, non-overlapping, ending inside the audio. Semantic rules are skipped when the shape check fails.
deferred_rules: wrong media kind in a slot (visual image/video; voiceover and music audio)  [SPEC.md]
first scene transition_in is null or a cut  [SPEC.md]
warning: video clip too short, trim_start_ms + scene duration > clip duration (loop/freeze/reject settled in F03)  [SPEC.md]
warning: total duration within +-25% of brief.target_duration_ms  [SPEC.md]
content_hash matches bytes at uri: render time, F06  [SPEC.md]
scene ids unique  [added by us, schema cannot express it]
trim_start_ms only on video assets  [added by us]
return warnings: {:ok, spec, warnings} once a warning rule exists

features.behavior: A fixtures/media folder with a few small CC0 images, one short video clip, a voice-over WAV and a music track, plus fixture specs that reference them with correct content hashes.

Rust CLI `retake_render <spec.json> [-o out.mp4]` parses a spec into strict typed structs (accepting spec/examples and fixtures, rejecting broken specs; D15) and renders image and video scenes with cover/contain fit, Ken Burns motion, video trim, a held last frame for short clips (D13) and cuts, to a 1080x1920 H.264 MP4 whose frame count follows the boundary-rounding rule in SPEC.md. Prints `progress n/total` and `done <path>` on stdout, `warning:` lines on stderr for features not built yet (D14). No audio (F05), no transitions/captions/overlays (F04).
sub_steps: 3a spec types + frame timeline (pure, unit tests)
3b compositing math: fit, motion, pixel tests (pure, unit tests)
3c media decode, encode, render loop, CLI, cuts.json fixture, probe-check
features.verification: cargo test -p retake_render && just render fixtures/specs/cuts.json && just probe-check fixtures/specs/cuts.json

features.behavior: Crossfade and fade-through-black transitions; text overlays; captions in phrase and word_highlight modes driven by word timings. Settles: bundled fonts as hashed assets.

Mix each scene's voice-over at its offset (gain_db respected) into one audio track muxed into the MP4, so a rendered video has narration. No music, ducking or loudness pass yet. Needed for the pipeline MVP.
features.verification: cargo test -p retake_render voiceover && just render fixtures/specs/minimal.json && just probe-check fixtures/specs/minimal.json

features.behavior: Music with fades and ducking under voice, and a final loudness pass to the spec target. Settles: loudness pass in Rust or FFmpeg loudnorm. After the pipeline MVP.
Rendering the same spec and assets twice produces byte-identical MP4s (D12 scope); asset content_hash is checked before use.
Elixir runs the renderer as a Port, streams progress lines, and returns the output path or a structured error.
Load config/providers.toml, select a profile, resolve providers with fallbacks, read keys from env, enforce rate limits and budget caps.

Retake.Storage (behaviour + local-disk backend) stores assets by content hash as store://assets/<sha256>.<ext>, with atomic writes, strict uri parsing and hash verification. Retake.Cache computes request_hash exactly as spec/examples do (sha256 of the Python-style canonical JSON of [provider, model, request]) and returns an existing result for a repeated request without calling the producer; it stores json or binary results, records provenance and cost, and treats a missing asset or corrupt entry as a miss. force: true bypasses it. Composing it with Retake.Providers.run lands in F10, its first user.
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/storage_test.exs test/retake/cache_test.exs

features.behavior: LLM turns a brief into a title and scene intents (narration, visual_query, optional on-screen text) using structured output, validated and retried on bad JSON; invalid replies are never cached. Includes the first real adapter (openai_compatible, via Req) and the call path every pipeline step will use: Retake.Providers.Client composes provider resolution, cache lookup per provider, fallbacks, rate limits and budget.
sub_steps: 10a Providers.Client: cache lookup per provider + providers.run + store, with an adapter registry and validate option (fake adapters in tests)
10b openai_compatible LLM adapter on Req (Req.Test stubs, no network)
10c Pipeline.Script: prompt, JSON schema, parse, validate, retry with feedback
10d mix retake.script for a real run with a Groq key; just setup copies providers.example.toml
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/providers test/retake/pipeline

features.behavior: For each scene, search stock (Pexels) for portrait video or photo, pick the best fit, store it with licence and attribution. Two calls per scene, both through Retake.Providers.Client and the request cache: a search (JSON candidates) and a download (bytes into Storage). Prefers a video long enough for the narration, else a photo; retries a broader query when nothing is found; records provenance, licence and attribution for the spec asset.
sub_steps: 11a pexels adapter on Req (search videos/photos, download with a host allowlist); per-adapter req_options in config
11b Pipeline.Stock.find: query, rank candidates, download, asset data for the spec
11c mix retake.stock / just stock for a real run with a Pexels key
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/providers test/retake/pipeline

features.behavior: TTS each scene's narration, then transcribe it to word timings; set scene durations from voice-over length plus padding.
sub_steps: 12a openai_compatible_speech adapter, Media.Wav, request normalisation hook
12b openai_compatible_transcription adapter with a storage context
12c Pipeline.Voice: speak, read duration, transcribe, tidy words, scene length
12d mix retake.voice, just voice, just kokoro
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/providers test/retake/media test/retake/pipeline

features.behavior: Prompt in, valid spec and MP4 out. Steps per scene run in parallel; progress events are broadcast; failures report which step and scene. Includes the videos/jobs table (Postgres), POST /api/videos, GET /api/videos/:id and media file serving with Range support. Music is not part of F13 (music: null until F05b; no CC0 library yet). A scene with no stock found fails the video, naming step and scene. Scenes join with cuts; captions and overlays are in the spec but rendered later (F04).
sub_steps: 13a Pipeline.Assemble: pure spec assembly (ids, durations, Ken Burns, validated)
13b Pipeline.run: parallel scenes, events, failures with step+scene, rate-limit wait, real render; offline e2e test with a scripted adapter and the real renderer
13c mix retake.video / just video: first real prompt-to-video run
13d videos table, Videos context, background Runner, PubSub events
13e HTTP API: POST /api/videos, GET /api/videos/:id, file with Range
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/pipeline_test.exs test/retake/videos_test.exs test/retake/videos test/retake_web/controllers/video_controller_test.exs

features.behavior: Scenes can get a generated image instead of stock: the script step also writes a visual prompt per scene (a generation prompt, richer than the stock search phrase); an image capability and adapter (hosted or free image model) behind Retake.Providers.Client; a Visuals step chooses generated or stock per scene from the profile; the image gets the renderer's zoom and pan; provenance source generated, with cost and the prompt; budget caps apply.
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/providers test/retake/pipeline

features.behavior: Scenes can get a generated video clip: a video capability and an adapter that submits a generation job and polls for the result (hosted API, or a local model if the GPU is free), cached by request hash, with cost estimate before the run and budget caps; a clip shorter than its scene follows the held-last-frame rule (D13).
features.verification: cd api && mix test test/retake/providers test/retake/pipeline
